- West Wing seed-153 corridor: job c074d4029e2a72d26e45c187c524c18f20135c8e038afac5de992848293d164b, 1,408 references, pushed in 84f05d7db. Exact 153→154→44545 route holds in all four bindings. Wall154 retains segment-only credit; all 118 bodies and prior negatives remain.
- Upton complete current-domain capture: job 69916bb92558c08c4c5c1838f7c34f963f0e888b7ef14cb489d995ab9bc36727, 7,895 references, pushed in 5406b27fa. Complete three originals, native79882, 1,911 base neighbours and 9,214 drawn terrain facets. Original failed serializer history preserved.
- Southside complete original-TIN comparison: job a3b5b315b784f978ab22d511b638106abb15ec334dc1aeabf428e80ccf83675c, 858 references and all 51,560 facet slots, pushed in fb2682f8f. Original terrain clears 643/943 mall and 350/513 station current failures. All four bindings retain 300/163 failures, with zero upward-nonsteep failures. Saved first pass was reused exactly after verified supervisor retirement.

Next gates: West Wing complete component contacts and typed support; Southside original-TIN grade/component context for 463 residual facets and 19 historical obligations; Upton full-domain neighbour regression before any terrain join. Upton's first regression attempt stopped before predicates on a saved-array schema mismatch; its lease is released and a narrow representation fix is being prepared. This is a script failure, not source corruption.

Acquisition skill updated to 1.9.55. Earlier native census and Yoho routing receipts remain valid historical/current-bound evidence as documented in the handoff. Original government geometry, scale and placement remain unchanged. Zero AI geometry modelling. Optimisation framework/loader are separate; no optimisation batch, variant approval or publication authorised for this acquisition run.
